archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Tactical Operations & Precision)

theme_strategy.vibe: Command-Center Tactical Operations for Warehouse Staff & Inventory Managers
theme_strategy.accent_highlights: Electric Amber (#F59E0B) for low-stock triggers, Tactical Emerald (#10B981) for validated receipts, Signal Crimson (#EF4444) for out-of-stock/critical exceptions, Cobalt Blue (#3B82F6) for transfers
theme_strategy.border_style: 1px crisp slate borders with subtle inner glow, cardless high-density sections or subtle 6px-8px rounded borders

typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono / Fira Code (Mandatory for SKUs, Batch numbers, Location Codes, Move Ledger IDs)
rules: DO NOT use generic centered titles for operations screens; left-align header title block with live metrics & quick-action toolbar.
All SKU codes (e.g., SKU-7892-BLK), Batch IDs (BAT-2026-004), and Location Codes (WH1-A2-S4) MUST be styled with font-mono and subtle tinted badges.
Overlines and table column headers must be uppercase text-xs tracking-wider text-muted-foreground font-semibold.

color_system.contrast_rules: All text elements must strictly pass WCAG AA / APCA standards. Set explicit hover text colors (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).

layout_and_grids.mode: MODE B: High Density Command Grid
layout_and_grids.dashboard_kpi_strip: grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4 (Total Units, Low Stock Alert Count, Pending Receipts, Pending Deliveries, Scheduled Transfers)
layout_and_grids.product_catalog_grid: bento format or dense filterable data table with quick detail drawer
layout_and_grids.stock_ledger_layout: full width data table with live filters, date range selection, location dropdown, and ledger entry expansion
layout_and_grids.containers: Containers with borders must include p-4 or p-6 internal padding to prevent text collision.

navigation_and_header.header_bar: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-md bg-background/80 border-b z-40) containing Brand Logo ('StockSense'), Active Warehouse Selector ('Central Whse A', 'West Hub B'), Search bar (SKU/Product scan), Low-Stock Notifications bell badge, Theme toggle, and Profile Menu with Role badge (Manager / Staff) and Logout.
navigation_and_header.sidebar: Collapsible operational sidebar with items: 1. Dashboard, 2. Products & Inventory, 3. Incoming Receipts, 4. Outgoing Deliveries, 5. Internal Transfers, 6. Stock Adjustments, 7. Stock Ledger / Move History, 8. Warehouses & Locations, 9. Settings / Seed Data Reset.

key_features_and_page_hierarchy.auth_flow: Email/password login & signup modal/page, OTP verification simulation screen, password reset flow, and quick 'Demo Manager' / 'Demo Staff' one-click auto-fill credentials button.
key_features_and_page_hierarchy.dashboard: KPI strip at top, visual alert bar for low/out-of-stock items, recent stock movements timeline, upcoming receipts & delivery queues.
key_features_and_page_hierarchy.product_crud: SKU catalog table with quick filters (Category, Location, Stock Status), Reorder threshold alert flags, stock by warehouse breakdown, and Modal for Add/Edit Product.
key_features_and_page_hierarchy.receipts_incoming: Receipt creation form (Supplier, Destination Whse, Expected Date, SKU lines + quantities), Receipt Validation workflow (Draft -> In-Transit -> Validated) which automatically updates total inventory.
key_features_and_page_hierarchy.delivery_orders_outgoing: Delivery order creation (Customer/Destination, Origin Whse, Line items), Validation workflow (Draft -> Picked -> Shipped/Validated) which decreases stock with negative quantity ledger entries.
key_features_and_page_hierarchy.internal_transfers: Multi-location move tool (Source Whse/Bin -> Target Whse/Bin, SKU, Quantity), Instant validation or scheduled transfer state.
key_features_and_page_hierarchy.stock_adjustments: Physical cycle count entry tool (Select Location + SKU -> Input Physical Count -> Calculate Variance +/- -> Validate Reason e.g. Damaged, Audit Discrepancy, Lost).
key_features_and_page_hierarchy.stock_ledger: Read-only Immutable Ledger showing every single unit movement with Timestamp, Movement Type (RECEIPT, DELIVERY, TRANSFER, ADJUSTMENT), SKU, Quantity Delta (+/-), Source, Destination, and User ID.
key_features_and_page_hierarchy.warehouses_management: Warehouse and Location/Bin hierarchy (e.g. Warehouse Alpha -> Zone A -> Shelf 04). Add/Edit Warehouse locations and view capacity metrics.
key_features_and_page_hierarchy.seed_demo_data: Include prominent 'Reset Demo Data' trigger in settings/header to allow instantaneous reload of realistic inventory, low-stock scenarios, and move history.

data_testing_and_attributes.rule: MUST add data-testid to every interactive and data element.

component_usage_rules.tables: Use Shadcn Table or TanStack Table with pagination, column sort, filter input, and sticky headers.
component_usage_rules.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog with customized dark/light panel and form validation.
component_usage_rules.toasts: Use Sonner for operational feedback (e.g., 'Stock receipt validated: +250 units added to Whse A').
component_usage_rules.date_pickers: Use Shadcn Calendar / Popover date pickers.
component_usage_rules.selects: Use Shadcn Select for warehouse location and status selection.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete MVP according to the PDF spec with FastAPI backend and React Tailwind frontend.
Ensure real-time/instant updates on UI whenever receipts, deliveries, transfers, or adjustments are validated.
Implement one-click demo data login buttons ('Login as Manager', 'Login as Warehouse Staff') on the login screen for instant demo reviewer testing.
Store all stock ledger entries immutably in MongoDB and display them in the Stock Ledger view with clear + / - color tags.
Add low-stock alert notifications in top header dropdown and dedicated dashboard exception section.
Support full responsive mobile view with bottom bar or slide-over drawer for warehouse staff scanning/checking on mobile devices.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, 💭, 💡, 🔮, 🎯) for icons; use Lucide or Phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, slide-ins.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All key interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
